messages:
Anya: Starting a quick thread to capture the hybrid GPTQ+AWQ bake we ran across Llama/Mistral/Qwen today. main goal: find a reproducible pipeline to get GPTQ-size wins while falling back to AWQ where GPTQ regresses.

Mike: high level numbers pls?

Anya: Summary first: Llama-2-13b -> GPTQ gave ~1.8% EM drop on instruction eval but 2.2x size reduction. Mistral-7b -> GPTQ stable (0.3% EM delta). Qwen-7b -> GPTQ had odd hallucination spikes on multi-step instructions, AWQ at 4-bit was safer (0.6% EM delta).

Lee: was the Qwen issue KV-cache related? saw something similar last sprint.

Anya: yes likely KV alignment. We ran two variants: 1) naive GPTQ (no KV fix), 2) GPTQ+kv-fix (remap offsets), 3) AWQ-4 dynamic. Only #2 reduced hallucination but increased latency ~12%.

Sasha: can you paste the exact bake commands?

Anya: sure, here's the run we used for reproducibility:
```bash
# GPTQ pass with kv-offset fix
./bake --model qwen-7b --quant gptq --kv-fix --chunk-size 2048 --seed 42 --eval instruction-suite

# AWQ fallback build
./bake --model qwen-7b --quant awq --bits 4 --group-size 128 --seed 42 --eval instruction-suite
```

Mike: what eval suite? promptsets + long-context instruction chaining?

Anya: instruction-suite = 3k curated prompts (instruction-following, step-wise reasoning, math). We also ran longctx-subset (4k tokens) to stress KV.

InfraBot: deploy snapshot created: snap-2026-03-15-qa-004 (artifacts: gptq/qwen-7b-kvfix, awq/qwen-7b-4bit).

Lee: Latency / cost notes?

Anya: ballpark numbers on p4d per-token median: FP16 baseline 1.0x latency, GPTQ (kv-fix) 1.12x, AWQ-4 0.78x. Cost per token roughly: baseline $0.00012, GPTQ $0.00009 (but slower), AWQ $0.00006.

Sasha: accuracy tradeoffs across families?

Anya: short list: 
- Llama-2-13b: GPTQ 1.8% EM delta, AWQ-4 2.9% delta (AWQ worse)
- Mistral-7b: GPTQ 0.3% delta, AWQ-4 0.7% delta
- Qwen-7b: GPTQ (no kv-fix) 4.5% delta + hallucinations, GPTQ+kv-fix 1.2% delta, AWQ-4 0.6% delta

Mike: interesting — suggests hybrid policy: prefer GPTQ on Llama/Mistral, AWQ fallback for Qwen unless kv-fix applied and latency budget allows.

Anya: exactly. Proposal for deployment profiles: 
- dev/hosted: AWQ-4 by default for Qwen-family to avoid regressions; GPTQ for Llama/Mistral to save cost.
- dedicated/enterprise: allow GPTQ+kv-fix option with SLA knob (latency vs accuracy).

Sasha: any regression checks we should add to CI?

Anya: add an instruction-following delta alert (>=1% EM regression over baseline) + hallucination frequency check (rate >0.5% flagged). Also include the longctx KV alignment smoke test (a simple chain-of-thought prompt that exercises cache >2k tokens).

Mike: can BakeBot generate a short report artifact?

BakeBot: created artifact: /artifacts/bakes/1718012345-hybrid-report.tar.gz (contains CSVs, eval diffs, heatmaps). :thumbsup:

Lee: next steps: 1) schedule small canary with GPTQ+kv-fix on qwen-7b for one hostpool, 2) add CI checks Sasha listed, 3) write up a short playbook for support. I'll take #1.

Anya: thanks — tagging @Mike and @Sasha for follow-ups on metrics and playbook. If anyone finds a weird sample, paste it here and we'll triage. :sparkles:
